title: Which Postgres operator fits a small cluster?
summary: Zalando's postgres-operator and CloudNativePG both fit; CloudNativePG needs fewer moving parts, Zalando is already running.

blocks.text:
Both operators manage **streaming replication** and backups. See the [CloudNativePG docs](https://cloudnative-pg.io/documentation/current/) and the [Zalando docs](https://postgres-operator.readthedocs.io/en/latest/ "Zalando").

- Zalando: one Secret per login, `username`/`password` keys.
- CloudNativePG: one `Cluster` resource, `a < b` holds for its footprint.

A query to check the grants:

```sql
SELECT grantee, privilege_type FROM information_schema.role_table_grants WHERE table_name = 'research_runs';
-- <none> means no grants yet
```

[docs]: https://www.postgresql.org/docs/17/sql-alterdefaultprivileges.html
